name: mark_task_as_completed
description: Mark one existing Sunsama task as done on the given day. WRITE - this changes state the user and their teammates see. Use it only when the user explicitly said that specific Sunsama task is finished; do not complete tasks inferred from a general remark such as 'I finished everything', complete several at once without naming each, or use it for subtasks (use mark_subtask_as_completed). It is not for tasks in any other app (Asana, Todoist, Jira, a calendar and so on).

taskId.description: The ID of the task to complete

finishedDay.description: The date the task was finished (YYYY-MM-DD format)
